script.heading: ca01 trailer script (Invoice fraud)
script.brief: Owner rules (settled on ca12, 2026-11-22): the trailer stands alone as a sell for the training, narrator VO about the course throughout; open on a strong in-game line (Gwen G2; E2 needs a 5.85 s shot, over the 5 s cold-open lint); open card with v1; name the topic in VO over footage that shows it; red chapter card, each attack step spoken over the footage that shows it; in-game cast lines, no narrator over a character line; blue chapter card and VO naming what to check; end on Adaeze's in-episode line (D336 default (a)+(c); R2: A3, caught branch, --set kit_key_caught=true); ca-close with "Play the attack · Learn to stop it" and the Hacktivity.co.uk call. Spoilers fine, no masks, no debrief cost line (D317), no music until D331. VO lengths budgeted at 2.3 words/s (Sulafat).

music.note: silent bed until D331; game room sound and voiced lines only
